_about: The name a release is shown with, by build number. The tag and the in-app updater use the whole build number (custom-16): the updater of every published build reads only whole numbers, so Build 15 users are offered custom-16 in the app. Owner decision 2026-11-22 (NVP15-CHG-0006): build 16 is shown as 15.5; the upstream-sync plan keeps the name Build 16.
